<script async defer>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    function attachAccordionListeners() {
      const toggles = document.querySelectorAll('[sw-accordion="toggle"]');
      if (!toggles.length) return;

      // Remove old listeners by cloning
      toggles.forEach(toggle => {
        const newToggle = toggle.cloneNode(true);
        toggle.parentNode.replaceChild(newToggle, toggle);
      });

      const cleanToggles = document.querySelectorAll('[sw-accordion="toggle"]');

      cleanToggles.forEach(toggle => {
        toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const component = toggle.closest('[sw-accordion="component"]');
          if (!component) return;

          if (component.classList.contains("w--open")) {
            component.classList.remove("w--open");
          } else {
            component.classList.add("w--open");
          }
        });
      });
    }

    // Initial attach
    attachAccordionListeners();

    const refreshers = document.querySelectorAll('[sw-accordion="refresh"]');

    refreshers.forEach(ref => {
      const isInput = ref.tagName.toLowerCase() === "input";

      if (isInput) {
        // INPUT → refresh after keydown
        ref.addEventListener("keydown", () => {
          setTimeout(() => {
            attachAccordionListeners();
          }, 200);
        });
      } else {
        // NON-INPUT → refresh after click
        ref.addEventListener("click", () => {
          setTimeout(() => {
            attachAccordionListeners();
          }, 200);
        });
      }
    });

  });

      const duration = parseFloat(durationAttr.replace("s", "")) || 7;

      let timer = null;
      let isInView = false;

      // --- Helpers ---
      function clearProgress(link) {
        const progress = link.querySelector('[sw-auto-tab="progress"]');
        if (progress) {
          progress.style.transition = "none";
          progress.style.transform = "scaleX(0)";
          progress.offsetHeight; // force reflow

      function animateProgress(link) {
        const progress = link.querySelector('[sw-auto-tab="progress"]');
        if (progress) {
          progress.style.transition = `transform ${duration}s linear`;
          progress.style.transform = "scaleX(1)";
        }

      function activateTab(index) {
        links.forEach((link, i) => {
          link.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index);
          clearProgress(link);
        });
        panes.forEach((pane, i) => {
          pane.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index);
        });

        animateProgress(links[index]);
        currentIndex = index;
      }

      function nextTab() {
        const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % links.length;
        activateTab(nextIndex);
        resetTimer();
      }

      function resetTimer() {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (isInView) {
          timer = setTimeout(nextTab, duration * 1000);
        }
      }

      // --- Manual clicks ---
      links.forEach((link, index) => {
        link.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          activateTab(index);
          resetTimer();
        });

      const observer = new IntersectionObserver(

    var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

    var rootFontSize = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize) || 16;
    var toRem = function (px) {
      return px / rootFontSize + 'rem';
    };

    // Desktop: all open, summary out of the tab order. Mobile: all closed.
    function applyMode() {
      all.forEach(function (d) {
        var s = d.querySelector('.nav-menu-summary');
        if (d._anim) {

          d._anim = null;
        }
        d.style.height = d.style.overflow = '';

          d.open = false;
          s.removeAttribute('tabindex');
        } else {

          s.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        }
      });
    }

    all.forEach(function (d) {
      var summary = d.querySelector('.nav-menu-summary');

      function animateTo(opening) {
        if (d._anim) d._anim.cancel();
        var start = toRem(d.offsetHeight);
        var end = toRem(opening ? d.scrollHeight : summary.offsetHeight);
        d.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        d._anim = d.animate({ height: [start, end] }, { duration: 400, easing: 'ease' });
        d._anim.onfinish = function () {
          d.open = opening;
          d.style.height = d.style.overflow = '';
          d._anim = null;
        };
      }

      summary.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!mobile.matches) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        if (nativeAnim || reduce.matches) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        var opening = !d.open;
        if (opening) {
          d.style.height = toRem(d.offsetHeight);
          d.open = true;
          requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            animateTo(true);
          });
        } else {
          animateTo(false);
        }
      });
    });

    applyMode();
    if (mobile.addEventListener) mobile.addEventListener('change', applyMode);
    else mobile.addListener(applyMode);
  })();
</script>
